verdict.rationale: Vercel documents Vercel Workflows and the Workflow SDK, which run multi-step logic as durable code. That code can retry failed steps, wait for external events, and resume across crashes and deployments on a fully managed platform. This delivers durable, long-running workflows as code without hand-wiring queues and retries. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and deeper documentation of long-running duration limits and the deploy workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy durable, long-running workflows as code without manually wiring queues and retries

citations.quote: Vercel Workflows runs multi-step logic as durable code that can retry failed steps, wait for external events, and resume across crashes and deployments.
Build durable, observable applications and AI agents with the Workflow SDK on a fully managed platform.
